title: Text to Word – Convert TXT to DOCX in Your Browser, Free
description: Turn plain text or a .txt file into a Word document in your browser: every line kept, Arabic set right to left. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Text to Word
subtitle: Paste text or open a .txt file and download it as a Word document, line for line; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert TXT to DOCX: type or paste text, or open a .txt file, and every line becomes a line in a Word document, blank lines included. Each line keeps its own direction, so Arabic reads right to left and English left to right in the same document. The document uses Calibri 11 and opens in Word, LibreOffice, Google Docs and Pages, ready to format. The text is converted in your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: The .docx is built inside your browser tab, so your words are not sent to any server.

features.title: One line, one paragraph
features.text: Each line of your text becomes its own Word paragraph, and a blank line becomes an empty paragraph, so the gaps you typed stay.

features.title: Arabic and English
features.text: Each line is set in its own direction, so mixed Arabic and English text reads correctly.

stepsTitle: How to convert text to Word

steps.title: Add your text
steps.text: Write or paste in the Text box, or choose or drop a .txt file to load it there; you can still edit it before converting.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the .docx file and format it in Word, LibreOffice, Google Docs or Pages.

handles: Input: a .txt file, or any text you write or paste in the box.
Every line as a paragraph, blank lines included; a long line wraps inside its paragraph in Word.
Lines whose first letter is Arabic are marked right to left in Word; the rest stay left to right.
limits: No formatting is guessed: lines that look like headings or lists stay plain lines. For headings and lists, write Markdown and use Markdown to Word.
Columns lined up with spaces or tabs may not line up in the document, because Calibri letters are not all the same width.
The document uses Calibri 11; change the font and size in Word afterwards.
A chosen .txt file can be up to 10 MB; a bigger one is turned away with a message.
worksBest: Emails and messages you want to keep as a document
Lists and logs to share or print
Arabic, English, or both in one file
mayNotKeep: Heading and list styles (lines stay normal paragraphs)

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I convert a text file to Word?
faq.answer: Word, LibreOffice and Google Docs can each open a .txt file and save it as .docx. In OpenAnyDoc, paste the text or open the .txt file, click convert and download the .docx with every line kept and each line in its own direction; the text is converted in your browser and never uploaded.

faq.question: How is each paragraph's direction chosen?
faq.answer: By its first letter. A paragraph that starts with an Arabic letter is marked right to left in Word, and one that starts with a Latin letter left to right, so both can sit in the same document.

faq.question: Will lines that look like headings be formatted?
faq.answer: No. Every line stays a plain line in Calibri 11. If you want real headings, lists and tables, write the text as Markdown and use Markdown to Word.

faq.question: Are blank lines kept?
faq.answer: Yes. Every line of your text, blank ones included, is a line in the document.

faq.question: Can I make a PDF instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Text to PDF lays the same lines out on A4 or Letter pages with text you can search.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
